payment_external_id.description: Payment identifier in the client's billing system.

plan_id.description: The plan the payment is for.

is_first_payment.description: Whether this is the Referee's first-ever payment.

trial_converted.description: Whether this is a trial-to-paid conversion.

product_id.description: Client identifier of the product purchased. Cross-Sell Pulse discriminator.

is_reactivation.description: Client asserts this payment re-activates a churned customer. Reactivation Pulse discriminator.

switched_from.description: Competitor the Referee asserts they switched from. Switch-Up Pulse discriminator; reward held until verified.
